text: It's late, and you're still scrolling.
Every option looks better than the one you're holding.
So you compare, you save, you wait, and nothing gets chosen.
That's the fear of missing something better.
Chapter three shows why choosing feels like losing, so you can pick one path and walk it.
It's one of eight chapters, from why planning feels like progress, to knowing when to persist, and when to pivot.
The Life You Keep Planning, by Belinda Bright N.
